text:
marta.designer: Quick design review — vectors preview in the batch inspector: noticed the export toolbar icons have low contrast and the tab/focus order feels off. Can we do a quick pass? I'm free for 15. :eyes: ryan.prod: can you drop the screenshot or figma link? marta.designer: will post figma in a sec. here's a quick proposal for DOM/ARIA order I sketched: ```html
``` oliver.frontend: I can implement aria-haspopup + menu handling. question: do we want visual order matching DOM order? keyboard users expect DOM order to be logical. kavita.a11y: Contrast note: the export icon sits at ~3.1:1 on white background — fails WCAG AA for small UI. Recommend darken to at least #263341 or add a 12% opaque bg to reach 4.5:1. Also prefer explicit aria-labels instead of title tooltips. :warning: a11y-bot: Automated check: toolbar-export-icon color #6b778c on #ffffff -> contrast ratio 3.1:1 (FAIL). Suggested color #263341 yields 4.6:1. ryan.prod: small copy tweak request: use 'Download vectors (.csv)' instead of just 'Export' in the button to reduce ambiguity in the export dialog. marta.designer: good call. Also let's change aria-label on the menu from "More export options" to "Export options" for brevity. oliver.frontend: If we keep visual order but reorder DOM we need to ensure focus styles still match. I can change DOM order so tabbing goes: Copy -> Export -> Options, but visually we can keep Export first if we want. Implementation note: prefer DOM reflect primary action last so keyboard users hit secondary first? open to discussion. kavita.a11y: UX convention: primary action last in toolbar sometimes trips keyboard flows. I vote for DOM = visual order and clear focus ring. Also add role="menu" only when it's a true menu. ryan.prod: Also flag the export button size — currently 24px icon only. For clarity on mobile+screenreaders maybe use text + icon at narrow widths. marta.designer: I'll update the Figma with the color change, copy, and the proposed DOM order. Will also add focus ring spec (2px solid #0a66ff). :thumbsup: oliver.frontend: I'll prototype the change and attach a branch. ETA end of day. kavita.a11y: I'll test keyboard + VO once branch is up and run axe. If anything else fails I'll post quick list. ryan.prod: can we do a quick sign-off today? if not, add to morning sync tomorrow. marta.designer: aiming for today; if not, queue for tomorrow's design review. thanks team! :sparkles:
